title: Chapter 525 - 525 Choice; Manuscript Accepted!
content:
Chapter 525 - 525 Choice; Manuscript Accepted!

Chapter 525 - 525 Choice; Manuscript Accepted!

525 Choice; Manuscript Accepted!

At this moment, the silver-framed elder sitting in the main seat cleared his throat and said, “Then, according to the rules, we’ll proceed with the final vote.

“Currently, there are 10 nominees. They’re Hawes, Lin Fan, Jarviten…

“Please pick up the pen and paper on the table and write down your choice. The person with the most votes will win this year’s Nobel Prize in chemistry!”

Everyone in the conference room exchanged glances.

Their expressions were all very solemn. After all, this was the highest award in the chemistry world.

Then, everyone slowly picked up their pens and papers.

After a crisp sound, everyone raised the white paper in front of them.

[Hawes!]

[Lin Fan!]

[Lin Fan!]

[Lin Fan!]

…

An overwhelming advantage!

There was no suspense!

The silver-rimmed glasses elder glanced around and said, “The winner of this year’s Nobel Prize in chemistry is…Hua Nation’s Lin Fan!”

The blonde woman helplessly lowered the paper in her hand.

…

On the other hand, similar things were happening in the conference rooms of the Nobel Committee for physics and the Nobel Committee for medicine.

Lin Fan had indeed made great achievements in physics and medicine.

However, during the discussion meeting a while ago, there was still a huge dispute.

It was because some famous scholars had also made great achievements in their own fields.

However, today’s voting meeting was not as intense as last time.

When some people suggested that Lin Fan should be the winner of this year’s Nobel Prize, those who opposed it all chose to acquiesce.

The Nobel Prize in physics was a little better.

This was because Lin Fan’s earthquake prediction device had shown its might and prevented an extremely terrifying disaster.

As a result, the earthquake prediction device was called a divine weapon!

If the creator of the physics world’s divine weapon could not win the Nobel Prize, it might have a huge impact on the credibility of the Nobel Prize.

For the sake of the bigger picture, they had to make some concessions.

Moreover, with the earthquake prediction device, Lin Fan was qualified to receive this reward.

…

In the conference room of the Nobel Prize in medicine, when someone proposed to choose Lin Fan, no one objected.

Hua Nation and Bear Country had great influence.

At this moment, Hua Nation could be said to have helped Bear Country a lot.

How could they not repay him?

Of course, the main reason was that Lin Fan had invented the human islet recovery drug that was so effective that it was enough for him to win a Nobel Prize.

…

At this moment, in the Nobel Peace Prize Committee conference room…

The atmosphere in the conference room was a little depressing.

Compared to the arguments in the other conference rooms, the Nobel Peace Prize Committee conference room was peaceful when they first gathered. Moreover, everyone gave their unanimous approval and confirmed the winner of this year’s Peace Prize.

Now, however, everyone chose to remain silent.

The white-haired old man sitting in the main seat coughed lightly and said, “The leader of the United States only started a war once and indirectly saved many lives. He’s a peace-loving person and is qualified to win the Nobel Peace Prize.”

After a pause, he continued, “Everyone is paying attention to the earthquake that happened in Bear Country a while ago, right?

“That earthquake was very terrifying. Fortunately, it did not cause too many casualties.

“It can be said that the credit goes to Professor Lin Fan, who invented the earthquake prediction device. He also has the qualifications to win the Nobel Peace Prize.”

After saying that, the white-haired old man glanced at everyone in the conference room and saw that they all nodded.

Thus, he continued, “In that case, this year’s Nobel Peace Prize will be decided by voting.

“There are a total of nine nominees for this year’s Nobel Peace Prize. They are Jalesley, Mike… and Lin Fan!”

When everyone heard this, they looked at each other.

Only then did they slowly write down the candidate they voted for.

“Lin Fan!”

“Lin Fan!”

“Lin Fan!”

…

All votes passed!

In fact, this was normal.

One had to know…

Lin Fan’s earthquake prediction device saved millions of lives.

If he did not win the Nobel Peace Prize and the award was instead given to the person who started a war…

They would be cursed to death.

Seeing this…

The old man sitting on the main seat heaved a sigh of relief.

After all, he was the person in charge of the Nobel Peace Prize.

If there was too big of a deviation, he would definitely suffer the most insults.

The white-haired old man said, “The winner of this year’s Nobel Peace Prize is… Lin Fan!”

…

Meanwhile, in the office of Jiangbei University.

Nie Zhenjiang, Liu Qianqian, Jiang Chaoqun, and the others were studying seriously.

At this moment, Hao Zhiwu, who was scrolling the internet, suddenly shouted excitedly, “Professor Lin, you’re on the trending searches again!”

“Where? Where?” Nie Zhenjiang, Liu Qianqian, Xia Bing, Xia Xue, and the others quickly surrounded him.

Especially Xia Bing and Xia Xue, they were the fastest.

As long as they heard good news about Lin Fan, they would be extremely excited and happy.

“Number one on the trending searches! Look… Thank you, Professor Lin Fan!”

“The magnitude 9.1 earthquake only caused less than 100 casualties. We really should thank Professor Lin!” Liu Qianqian said seriously.

Xia Bing, Xia Xue, Nie Zhenjiang, and the others nodded.

Lin Fan gently stroked the cat, Lil White, and rubbed his ears. “Don’t be so agitated.”

Hao Zhiwu and the others were not in the mood to study these past few days. They continued to pay attention to the news of the earthquake in Wuka City.

As soon as they saw the trending searches about Lin Fan, they would let out a wave of excited cries. This shocked Lin Fan so much that his ears hurt.

At this moment, an email popped up on Lin Fan’s computer.

It turned out to be the editorial department of CL. They had replied to Xia Bing and Xia Xue’s last paper.

CT was one of the top journals in the field of computer science. It received countless manuscripts every day.

If it were not for the help of the super smart watch, it would have been considered fast to receive a reply in 10 days.

Lin Fan said, “Xia Bing, Xia Xue, the thesis you submitted to the journal last time has been accepted. It’ll be published in the next issue of the journal.”

The manuscript for the journal was accepted!

Hao Zhiwu, Nie Zhenjiang, Liu Qianqian, and Jiang Chaoqun all shouted excitedly.

“Xia Bing, Xia Xue, congratulations!”

“You guys are so powerful! That’s a top computer science journal!”

“Congratulations!”

“That’s great!”

Xia Bing and Xia Xue were equally happy.

They were not happy because their thesis was published in the top journal.

It was because they and Lin Fan had created this thesis together.

It was like their child had grown up!

Looking at how happy everyone was, Lin Fan seemed to have been infected by it as he smiled.

At this moment, the phone in his pocket rang.
